title: pysentimiento: A Python Toolkit for Opinion Mining and Social NLP tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Equity Evaluation Corpus (ECC) by analyzing sentences with minimal variations in names associated with different races (European and Afro-American). The fairness is measured using statistical parity and the Disparate Impact (DI) metric on a multi-label emotion detection task.
